The Food Consumption Score Nutritional Quality Analysis (FCS-N) is a tool derived from the Food Consumption Score indicator, that looks at three main nutrients (Vitamin A,Protein and Hem Iron) of the food items consumed. The gathered data from this FCS-N module is essential for understanding nutritional health and well-being of households. The FCS is calculated by inspecting how often households consume food items from the different food groups during a 7-day reference period.In addition to this, the FCS-N module collects data on sources of the consumed foods acquired by households.


More details on the indicator can be found here: https://vamresources.manuals.wfp.org/docs/food-consumption-score-nutritional-quality-analysis-fcs-n

 
# Indicator Calculation 

## FCS - nutrition

```{r}
##Calculate FSN-N

# Label FCSN relevant variables -----------------------------------------------#


# Food144a - Eggs
# Food141a - fish, meat or eggs
# Food143a - Fish/shellfish:  fish, including canned tuna, escargot, and / or other seafood
# Food142a  Organ meat:  liver, kidney, heart and / or other organ meats

table(main$Food14.4a) ## eggs

main$FCSNPrMeatF <- main$Food14.1a 
main$FCSNPrMeatO <- main$Food14.2a 
main$FCSNPrFish <- main$Food14.3a 
main$FCSNPrEggs <- main$Food14.4a 

main$FCSNVegOrg <- main$Food15.1a 
main$FCSNVegGre <- main$Food15.2a 

main$FCSNFruiOrg <- main$Food16.1a

```

```{r}
var_label(main$FCSNPrMeatF) <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Flesh meat"
var_label(main$FCSNPrMeatO) <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Organ meat"
var_label(main$FCSNPrFish)  <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Fish/shellfish"
var_label(main$FCSNPrEggs)  <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Eggs"
var_label(main$FCSNVegOrg)  <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Orange vegetables (vegetables rich in Vitamin A)"
var_label(main$FCSNVegGre)  <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Green leafy vegetables"
var_label(main$FCSNFruiOrg) <- "Consumption in past 7 days: Orange fruits (Fruits rich in Vitamin A)"
	


# Compute aggregates of key micronutrient consumption -------------------------#

## Vitamin A-Rich Foods -------------------------------------------------------#

main <- main %>% mutate(FGVitA = FCSDairy +FCSNPrMeatO +FCSNPrEggs +
                                 FCSNVegOrg +FCSNVegGre +FCSNFruiOrg)
var_label(main$FGVitA) <- "Consumption of vitamin A-rich foods"

## Protein-Rich Foods ---------------------------------------------------------#

main <- main %>% mutate(FGProtein = FCSPulse +FCSDairy +FCSNPrMeatF +
                                    FCSNPrMeatO +FCSNPrFish +FCSNPrEggs)
var_label(main$FGProtein) <- "Consumption of protein-rich foods"

## Iron-Rich Foods ------------------------------------------------------------#

main <- main %>% mutate(FGHIron = FCSNPrMeatF +FCSNPrMeatO +FCSNPrFish)
var_label(main$FGHIron) <- "Consumption of heme iron-rich foods"

## recode into nutritious groups  ---------------------------------------------#

##Replace NA with 0 as this part was not asked if main part was 0

main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    FGVitACat = case_when(
      FGVitA == 0 ~ 1,
      between(FGVitA, 1, 6) ~ 2,
      FGVitA >= 7 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 1  # If NA or any other case, set to 1
    ),
    FGProteinCat = case_when(
      FGProtein == 0 ~ 1,
      between(FGProtein, 1, 6) ~ 2,
      FGProtein >= 7 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    FGHIronCat = case_when(
      FGHIron == 0 ~ 1,
      between(FGHIron, 1, 6) ~ 2,
      FGHIron >= 7 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  )


# define variables labels and properties for FGVitACat FGProteinCat FGHIronCat
main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(c(FGVitACat, FGProteinCat, FGHIronCat), 
                ~labelled(., labels = c(
                  "Never consumed" = 1,
                  "Consumed sometimes" = 2,
                  "Consumed at least 7 times" = 3
                ))))

main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(c(FGVitACat, FGProteinCat, FGHIronCat),
                ~factor(., levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                           labels = c("Never consumed", "Consumed sometimes", 
                                   "Consumed at least 7 times"))))

var_label(main$FGVitACat)    <- "Consumption group of vitamin A-rich foods"
var_label(main$FGProteinCat) <- "Consumption group of protein-rich foods"
var_label(main$FGHIronCat)   <- "Consumption group of heme iron-rich foods"
```

```{r}
table(main$FGVitACat)
table(main$FGProteinCat)
table(main$FGHIronCat)
```

```{r}


FDS_XXX_202X_main <- main %>%
  filter(!is.na(wgh_samp_pop_restr)) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    strata=samp_strat,
    weights = wgh_samp_pop_restr, # Specify the column with survey weights
    nest = TRUE              # Use TRUE if PSUs are nested within clusters )
  )

dat_wb$FGVitACat <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07, FGVitACat) %>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup()

dat_wb$FGHIronCat <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07, FGHIronCat)%>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup()

dat_wb$FGProteinCat <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07, FGProteinCat) %>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup()
```
